parsed.evidence: The bright, unmodified pixels in the spotlight views (particularly visible in the wide view on the right and the cluster in the center) display distinct rectangular shapes with flat, uniform surfaces. These features are characteristic of industrial or residential rooftops, many of which appear to be made of metal sheeting (indicated by the blue/grey colors and linear textures). The organized, grid-like arrangement of these structures further supports classification as buildings within an urban or semi-urban settlement.
